message: Last weekend I decided to have a little family fun by testing our smoke alarms the old-fashioned way—by actually making a snack in the kitchen. 🍳 Sure, we had a few giggles about the alarms going off, but it reminded us how important it is to have a fire escape plan. Sometimes, a little low-tech fun leads to important conversations at home. What’s your favorite way to stay safe while having fun?
